newsitem.title: USA: Ashland to redeem convertible preferred.
newsitem.headline: Ashland to redeem convertible preferred.

text.p: Ashland Inc said Friday it plans to call for the redemption on April 7 of all the outstanding shares of its $3.125 Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock.

In accordance with the terms of the $3.125 Series, the redemption price will be $51.88 per share plus $0.191 per share of accrued and unpaid dividends. The $3.125 Series regular quarterly dividend of $0.78125 per share will be paid on March 15 to holders of record on February 24. However, shareholders who convert their shares prior to March 15 will not receive the regular quarterly dividend.

Ashland said there are 6 million shares outstanding in the $3.125 Series. Each share is convertible into 1.546 shares of Ashland common, plus cash for any fractional shares, equivalent to a conversion price of $32.343 for each share of Common Stock. Under the redemption terms of the $3.125 Series, shares may not be converted after April 1, 1997, it noted.
Harris Trust & Savings Bank has been appointed as redemption and conversion agent.

Shareholders who elect to convert their shares of the $3.125 Series into Stock from March 17 through March 31 will receive the dividend of $0.78125 per share. Because the dividend record date for Ashland's Common Shares was also February 24, 1997, preferred shareholders would not be eligible to receive the common stock dividend upon conversion, the company pointed out.
